messages:
anna_sales: Quick sync — Emerald POC kickoff. Need to align success criteria, timeline, security blockers, and pricing for the deal. Proposed 30m Wed 10:00am PT. Agenda I have in mind: 1) scope & primary use cases, 2) eval prompts + dataset, 3) infra & deployment option (hosted vs VPC), 4) security questionnaire status, 5) pricing/credit for POC. @devon_se @lisa_security @kevin_pm @raj_engineer @chris_ops please confirm availability and add any must-cover items.

devon_se: I can make Wed 10. Quick notes: product wants latency p95 < 200ms for gen flows and token cost target ~ $0.02/token equivalent during POC. We should nail the eval metric up front — suggest retrieval+RAG: recall@10 for retrieval, and human-rated helpfulness >= 4/5 on 100 samples.

lisa_security: I'll bring the customer security checklist. Two immediate Qs: do they require SOC2 + contractual data residency? Also need to know whether they'll push data to hosted API or need a Private (VPC/on-prem) option. If hosted, we need IP retention and subprocessor disclosures answered before starting ingestion.

kevin_pm: From PM side: success criteria proposals: 1) intent extraction accuracy >= 80% on their 10k ticket sample, 2) embeddings recall@10 >= 0.85 on provided eval set, 3) end-to-end latency < 300ms for the chat path (including retrieval). POC timeline I'm thinking 2 weeks: week1 data ingest + baseline, week2 tuning + demo and handoff. Can we commit to that?

raj_engineer: Infra notes: we'll need a sanitized sample dataset — at least 1k real queries with expected labels and ~10k historical docs for retrieval. Also confirm redaction requirements (PII) and whether they want us to run with quantized models (q4_0 / q4_8bit) to hit cost targets. For hosted POC we can spin a dedicated pool for the two weeks.

chris_ops: On pricing/credits: sales Ops can offer $5k POC credit plus a temporary 20% discounted rate for the POC window. Need legal sign-off on that and a short SOW email. Also flagging a potential enterprise blocker: they may expect SLA language for uptime even during POC — we typically provide best-effort for POCs unless they're on Dedicated.

anna_sales: FYI customer already sent their 40-question security doc last week — I uploaded to Zendesk (ticket #4921). @lisa_security can you triage the high-risk items before Wed? Regarding pricing, yes let's propose $5k credit + 20% discount; will add to SOW draft. On deployment, customer said they prefer hosted initially but may require VPC if legal flags it.

legal_bot: NDA v3 and standard POC SOW template uploaded to /legal/drafts.anna_eml. Reminder: any customer-requested SLA or data residency clause requires Legal review.

devon_se: For the eval prompts, here's a small starter set to bring to the call — please paste into your eval harness:```
Prompt: "Summarize the customer support ticket in 1-2 sentences and output 3 intent tags"
Example Input: "Customer can't login after password reset, sees 502 error, urgent"
Expected Output: "Login failure: password reset flow broken; Tags: [auth, urgent, bug]"
```

anna_sales: Great — added that to the agenda. Two discovery Qs for Wed: 1) who is the technical owner on their side (name + Slack/email), 2) will they provide the labeled eval set or do we need to build labels from their SMEs? If they can't, we should budget for annotation (~$1.5k for 1k labels).

lisa_security: I'll prioritize the top 8 questionnaire items and flag anything that mandates Private deployment. If there's PII in the sample dataset we'll need a data-handing attestation from them.

kevin_pm: One more: report format for success — do they want a notebook + runbook + post-POC recommendations deck? I propose notebook + playbook + a 30-min walkthrough.

raj_engineer: Ack on artifacts. Also will prepare a quick perf run script and cost-estimate snapshot so we can show token cost vs latency tradeoffs in the demo.

chris_ops: I'll draft the SOW + credit language after the call and route to Legal. If Legal flags anything, we'll convert to a short addendum.

anna_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll send calendar invite for Wed 10:00am PT and drop the Zendesk link and SOW draft in the thread. Agenda updated to include devon prompt set, lisa's security triage, and cost snapshot from raj. Anything else? :thumbsup:
